  ContinuousOn V (Set.Ici 0) →
    ∀ (st : ℝ),
      0 ≤ st →
        ∀ (t : ℝ),
          st ≤ t →
            V st + 1 ≤ V t →
              ∃ a, OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.completion V st = some a ∧ st ≤ a ∧ a ≤ t ∧ V a ≤ V st + 1

∀ {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Option ℝ) (l : List (Fin n)),
  (∀ (j : Fin n) (a : ℝ),
      OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.earliest c l = some (j, a) →
        c j = some a ∧ ∀ i ∈ l, ∀ (b : ℝ), c i = some b → a ≤ b) ∧
    ((∃ i ∈ l, ∃ b, c i = some b) → ∃ j a, OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.earliest c l = some (j, a))
